_comment: 26.4.0 is WINDOWS ONLY -- no macos block, so Mac users are told an update exists but get no in-app download and are pointed at the notes page instead. release_url/notes_url deliberately point at the PUBLIC notes page on this host, not at the GitHub release: the app repo is private, so a release URL 404s for every tester and for anyone signed out. publish-feed.sh defaults those two fields to the GitHub tag URL, so they must be corrected by hand every time. Windows is self-signed (real Authenticode + timestamp) so SmartScreen still warns.
